    Nested Sections
    Every part has a chapter, and every chapter has a scene.
    The fixture
    Part One
    The House
    Nothing is simple when a door stands open.
    An old proverb
    Chapter 1. Arrival
    The Gate
    The road ended at a wooden gate, and behind it a narrow path led up to the house.
    At the door
    Nobody answered the knock, so Anna pushed the door and stepped inside.
    The Lantern
    A lantern in the hall,
    a shadow on the wall,
    a step upon the stair,
    and no one waiting there.
    Anonymous
    The Letter
    On the table lay a letter, folded twice and sealed with red wax.
    Whoever reads this has come too late, or just in time.
    From the letter
    Anna read it twice and put it in her pocket.
    Chapter 2. The Inventory
    What the House Held
    She counted everything she found in the three rooms.
    The books, she decided, would take the longest.
